reviews.text: Our 3 American Bully’s, have received emergency care and routine visits. From the staff at the desk, to the vets, everyone is very friendly, professional and informative.

Absolutely hands down the best place to bring your pets for treatment. I have been to many vets and I am telling all of you who are reading this post that this is the place to have your pets treated. You will not be disappointed.

I DONT RECOMMEND this clinic so I bring my dog for his appointment for a kennel cough and Dr. Moreno exam my pet and I couldnt understand what she was saying her English are bad and on top of that the medicine she gave me for my dog it wasn’t improving nothing.And while the dr was examining my pet she had her pet on a leash and I felt uncomfortable, pet was wandering all over the clinic while there were multiple pets in the lobby. So I went to a different vet. But the receptionist and the tech are so nice.

Emma and Jason were absolutely wonderful! They were so kind, supportive, and compassionate during a difficult moment with Siena. Their encouragement and kindness meant so much to me. Thank you both for making me feel cared for! ❤️🐾 …
TERRIBLE SERVICE! On my very first visit to this clinic, I had an appointment booked several days in advance, and when I called to confirm, my sick dog wasn't listed. 🤨🙁 …

Unbelievably amazing staff here. I’ve been to many vets and have never encountered such kind, welcoming, warm help. My friend brought in 4 kittens and stray mom cat for help with a very intense flea infestation on all. They made the overwhelming process so easy and organized. You can really tell they truly love and care for animals and it was much cheaper than other vets!!

We have been going to Dr Hernandez for 20+ years , he”s always professional & doesn’t charge for things you don’t need , always upfront with treatment & fees
We drive an hour just to get our beagle his shots with him , that’s how much we appreciate his service

This is my to go place for my pets I live literally 5 min away and I have been going here for more than 3 years. While everything in this place is great what is NOT is that some receptionist can be so damn rude to the point to just hang up the phone while you trying to call for appointment or even have you waiting on the phone line for more than 15 min and then just hang up!!! This happened to me today! The person just keep hanging up the phone and when finally answered he had me waiting and then just hang up! I called back and in the best rude way he tells me can I call you back? I am very busy! And I'm like ok but you could say that instead of have me waiting for 15 min and just hanging up! He didn't care! He just said Yeah Im busy and right now... He kept going and I hang up on him! See if you like that right!
I'm like is he for real? I'm really frustrated with this right now because they were supposed to call me back to schedule rhis follow up appointment for my cat and a whole week past already and they never did! Until I'm trying to get this appointment and this insane stuff happens! Incredible! 😒😠

IF YOU ARE LOOKING FOR A GOOD VET, I WOULDN'T  RECOMMEND COMING IN AND SEEING DR MORENO. SHE SEEN MY PUPPY AND TOOK 1 HOUR TO COME INTO THE ROOM GAVE ME MEDICATION THAT DID NOT EVEN WORK I HAD TO TAKE MY PUPPY TO THE EMERGENCY AND IN TOP OF THAT SHE TAKES FOREVER AND I CAN'T EVEN UNDERSTAND HER. THIS CLINIC NEEDS DOCTORS THAT SPEAK ENGLISH WELL!!!! THEY ALSO HAD A LOOSE DOG IN THE CLINIC KNOWING THERE ARE BIG DOGS THAT CAN COME IN AND ANY INCIDENT CAN HAPPEN. OTHER THAN THAT I APPRECIATE THE RECEPTIONIST AND THE TECHS THAT TRIED HELPING ME OUT
Great service, and genuinely care for your animals health. 10/10

incompetent Staff. Took my dog here a couple times. After they get your money they dont care to follow up or even answer the phone!!! Went in for follow up for dog, I had to do my own research on what could be helpful for my dog severe arthritis and ask about a shot that helps. They finally answered the phone again asked if they have that option available for him they said YES. Made the appointment for this shot. Got there had us wait in the room for like an hour, just for them to come and tell us "OH WE DONT HAVE IT" what do you mean you dont have it thats the whole reason for the appointment! They said well give you a call once we get it back in like a week! OK I GUESS. & YES WE STILL HAD TO PAY FOR THE APPOINTMENT even tho we came for NOTHING. Time wasted, & money wasted. Unacceptable. MIND YOU its been over a month and they never called to say hey come in we got the shot ready for him. NOTHING!!

I had my first visit last week with Dr Hopkins she was great, hope to see her again soon. Front Desk Emma & Jason were really nice and attentive & the technician her name is Liz. They were really great. They get really busy but they add great overall. Definitely recommend coming in and seeing Dr. Hopkins ❤️

I've tried to call three times and have not been able to get through to anyone. Was considering switching to this clinic since it's closer to my place but if they can't be bothered to answer the phone I think I'll look elsewhere

Great staff and Great Doctor! I’ve been going here for 15 plus years with no regrets. They actually care about the animals and after all this time basically became family! I appreciate everything they do!

We were so lucky to have Dr.Hernandez take care of our sweet cat Maggie. He basically saved her life!! I will always recommend him! He is kind and gentle with his animals. He takes his time and makes sure that you understand everything that is going on with your animals. His prices are very reasonable because he understands that we are hard working people and we want the best for our animals. I want to say thank you Dr.Hernandez for everything you do for us.
Thorough, knowledgeable, and dont try to overbill for unnecessary stuff.

So I spent a better part of hour trying to call  these people. For the verification of my cat at pets smart for the rabies shot  because they didn't pick up the phone. I had to drive here to get a paper.long story short she say I'm the only one here and they're short staffed. And she has people on hold on top of forwarding calls, now my cat haircut appointment was cancelled. They need to do better.

I had a great experience at this veterinary office. The doctor was very kind, patient, and took the time to answer all of my questions. My dog can get nervous during appointments, but the staff made her feel comfortable and treated her with so much care. I really appreciated how thorough they were and how clearly they explained everything. It’s obvious that they genuinely care about their patients and their owners. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a compassionate and knowledgeable veterinarian!
everyone is always so helpful & answered all the questions i needed. since i’ve visited with my dogs, i haven’t trusted going anywhere else than here.

Dr. Hernandez is very knowledgeable and great with our chihuahua, and the entire staff is very helpful and sweet. Our dog had a teeth cleaning and we were nervous, but they did an excellent job of reassuring us—they go above and beyond. The only place we trust with our little guy! :)

Dr. Hernández is a terrific vet, it’s clear that he really cares about the animals he treats.

04/2026 update: My dog was terribly ill and the emergency vet couldn’t diagnose the problem.  Dr. Hernandez stepped in and now he’s recovering.  He stayed late and called in an ultrasound specialist on short notice.

I have been going here for at least 10 years. Dr Hernandez is an excellent veterinarian.  He caught things my previous veterinarians missed. His prices are affordable and he won't recommend any unnecessary tests or treatments. The office is very clean and his staff are very knowledgeable and helpful. Him and his staff deeply care about animals.
I’ve been calling for the last week and nobody answered the phone… anyone else have the same problem? Or this place is closed?
I’ve been bringing my pets here for the last decade. I really appreciate the supportive care they provide! Dr Hernandez is very kind and personable!

I’ve been bringing all of my fur babies to Dr. Hernandez for many years, and I truly can’t say enough wonderful things about him and his team. Dr. Hernandez and his staff are always kind, compassionate, and understanding in every situation. They take the time to answer all of my questions and address any concerns without ever making me feel rushed. You can tell they genuinely care about the fur babies and the families who love them. I’m so grateful to have a vet I completely trust!

I want to express my deepest gratitude to the entire team at this veterinary clinic. The level of care and genuine human compassion we received was exceptional from the very beginning. My chihuahua came in with a serious issue in her little paw, and thanks to their professionalism, commitment, and empathy, they were able to save it.

On top of the outstanding medical care, this clinic was the most economically accessible option we found, which truly matters when you love your pet and are facing an urgent situation. They scheduled the surgery as soon as possible and took the time to explain everything with patience and kindness.

This is a place where they don’t just care for animals—they care for families. Endless thanks for your dedication and heart.

I called and the receptionist was so kind and helpful! I also work in customer service, so I really appreciate when someone goes above and beyond to make a great impression. You can tell they genuinely care—not just about the people who call, but also about the animals they help every day. The receptionist (a friendly guy with a cheerful voice) was patient, informative, and made me feel totally comfortable. It’s nice to see people who truly love what they do. Thank you for taking such good care of both pets and their owners! ❤️

I’ve been taking both of my first babies here to the clinic. For many years. Now, Dr Hernández be respectful and attentive, thorough understanding, doctor. Has been attending my babies I love the staff here, full of joy and happiness. The receptionist Even though they only have one person day, they’re super communicative. Answer my Questions, so warming and caring over the phone also these damn comments from Un. Attentive people are the problem it’s NOT THE RECEPTIONS ITS THE RUDE ITS THE PEOPLE THAT UN CARE DOE THERE PETS WHEN ITS TO LATE.
One of the best vet clinics I've been to. The staff there is super nice and helpful. The receptionist is very friendly, knowledgeable, and follows up with phone calls after our appointments.

I called and the receptionist was super rude. I work for customer service and I have bad days but never gets to the point where I treat customer rudely. I don’t know about any of you but as someone who loves my pet, I cannot imagine if they treat humans so rudely can you imagine how they treat animals? Weird. The receptionist was a male with a high pitch voice, hi receptionist, if you’re reading this…it’s okay to quit your job and let someone who’s kind to take over. Hope you find love in what you do. Or I hope you have better days then today I guess. Just an FYI ALL LOVE :)

I cannot say enough about how grateful we are for Dr. Hernandez and his team. They are amazing humans who love and care for your pets as much as you do. I have had great experiences each time I go in from unplanned emergency visits to our annual appointments. Thank you for caring about your community and their beloved furry family members. Highly recommend!!!
So kind and so helpful
Friendly staff
They don't have a receptionist; you call and call and nobody answers.

Dr. MARTIN is hands down the best Dr and  PHENOMENAL surgeon i have gone too and his staff are amazing I highly recommend this vet.. Dr Martin has performed surgery 2 times for 2 different occasions and they both went great.
Doc did a great job with my babygirl Luna. They made her feel calm, they worked w my budget and Ive been able to do all of my appts during my lunch hour. Big plus. Also staff is super friendly.
My dog had his first deep cleaning and it was such a great experience! Dr. Hernandez was excellent and the staff always so caring and professional!

My partner and I have been bringing our first fur baby here for about 2 years now. The first year of having Sol he had a lot of health issues, we had to constantly bring him in. The biggest thing we came against was Sol eating hair ties and q-tips which required a surgery only 6 months into having him. Surgery and post surgery went so so smoothly. We just found our second fur baby and will be bringing them both in for all their needs.
They’ll do everything they can to make sure your pets are safe. Dr. Hernandez and his team have never left any of our questions unanswered.

I really love this place. I have been coming here for about 15 years. The staff and doctor are extremely professional, and friendly. Dr. Hernandez is such a wonderful doctor and is very caring. I wouldn’t go anywhere else.
Friendly staff  welcoming environment  clean rooms … staff has patience when it comes to pets with   anxiety or just scared . Love the details the vet provides before and after care ❤️

Terrible decisions they made first of all they just tried to get money out of us made us buy pill for my dog then call us that is can make his seizure worse then said we could get a blood test then a vaccine for dewormed like what. You guys need to be more carful of what u decide 🙄 but the rest ig is fine they check up on my dog so …
I love this place! They’re so wonderful and patient especially Jason. He was so good at answering my questions I had about my fur babies

10/10 service here, the staff were amazing here to me and my pet especially Jason. He was very helpful and patient when answering all my questions! I will definitely be coming here for my next pet visit!

One of the best vet clinics in chicago. Dr Hernandez and the staff are amazing. They always make you feel welcome. The staff is very friendly, attentive and caring with my dog Milo.I definitely recommend 💯. …
Rude people answering the phones disgusting service

Never been treated like this before !
I called on Monday about bringing my dog there was told bring her in at 330 on Wednesday. I get there and was treated as if I had a freaking disease or as if I was coming to steal from them DONT BRING YOUR PET THERE UNLESS YOUR THE RIGHT COLOR! U treat me like that but have a man working there with press -ons SERIOUSLY!
this place was great and everyone was very kind

Dr. Hernandez and the staff are amazing! They’re always kind, attentive, and make my dogs feel comfortable. The care and service here is top-notch—10/10! My dogs always feel comfortable during their visits.

Been bringing my dog for more than 10 years and I can definitely say Doctor Hernandez is amazing!!  and definitely knows what he’s doing and his experience as well. So ignore the rude and negative comments that are in here because it is not true.! People have to understand that these techs and the doctor as well have a stressful job it is not easy so definitely have compassion for them.!!
Best Vet Clinic in the city!  Dr. Hernandez.
Finally a Vet with reasonable prices. Thank you Fullerton Animal Clinic. I just took my two pets for dental cleaning without breaking the bank
Our trusted veterinary clinic provides excellent service. Dr. Hernández is very kind to our pets and answers all our questions and concerns. Excellent service! 👍🏼 …

I love the staff they are very sweet and kind. They answer with a very good explanations. They explain what they will be doing and what to do at home when I took my dog. She will be going for her spayed and I can comfortably leave her to them because I know she is safe with them.
Dr. Hernandez and his staff are great! They always take care of my pretty girl. And they are really friendly!!! I totally recommend him to anyone who has a furry baby🐾👍🥰 …
I really loved it, they have excellent service, everyone answered my questions kindly at all times. If you visit, you'll see that there are still places like this.

The girls who made the appointment were great. They answered all my questions as best as they could, even their advice was good. Buuut the vet that works there is very mean, negative and rude. Scolding me and making me feel bad about my senior dog. I don't think any vet is allowed to make the owner feel even sadder when given the news of their dying dog. The vet needs ro learn compassion empathetic skills. That was unacceptable and disgusting as a human being. Never met a vet as cold as him. Never coming back.

I was trying to schedule a visit for feline vaccines, but the lady that answered hung up on me. I was confused about requiring a physical just to get vaccines done. I was about to explain that my cats have already recently had their annual physical, and only need their rabies vaccines updated, but before I could get a word in, she got frustrated and hung up without saying goodbye or anything. Wow. Glad to know ahead of time before wasting my time and money on this place, and I'm extremely glad to find out about this behavior before giving my $75 deposit over the phone. I'm honestly not even surprised that their website is offline. What a shame.
